name: DescribeAccessControlLists

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the access control policy group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the access control policy group. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), and underscores (_). The name must be unique within a region. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组名称。访问控制策略组名称。长度限制为1~80个字符，只支持中文、字母、数字和半角句号（.）、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）和下划线（_）。访问控制策略组名称必须为地域内唯一。访问控制策略组名称支持模糊查询
parameters.name: acl_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP type of the instance attached to the access control policy group. Valid values:

ipv4: The IP address of the SLB instance is of the IPv4 type.

ipv6: The IP address of the SLB instance is of the IPv6 type
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组绑定的实例的IP类型。取值：

ipv4：负载均衡实例的IP地址是IPv4类型。

ipv6：负载均衡实例的IP地址是IPv6类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值：50，默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value
